HSPT.description: Heat of Hydration Prescribed Temperature Load (HSPT). Keyed by element/entity id; each entry carries an ITEMS array where every item defines a prescribed temperature, optionally scoped to a boundary group.

ITEMS.description: List of prescribed temperature items assigned to this entity key. Each item sets a temperature value, optionally tied to a boundary group name.

ID.description: Serial number identifying the item within this entity key. Used to match/replace an existing item; 0 lets the program assign a serial.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name this prescribed temperature applies to. Empty string means no group; a non-empty name must reference an existing boundary group or the request is rejected.
